summary: Iteration-8 deployment fixes validated end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_deployment_fixes_iter8.py (26 new tests, all PASS). Full backend suite: 139/139 PASS in 103s. (1) Health endpoints — /api/health & /api/healthz via public ingress avg ~45ms p99 <200ms, root /health & /healthz via internal :8001 in 2-10ms; all return {status:'ok'} without DB. (2) Seed users — all 4 demo accounts (9000000000 admin, 9000000001 client, 9000000002 worker, 9000000003 contractor) login successfully after the 2s startup sleep + background seed. (3) Newly limited queries — /jobs/mine, /applications/mine, /applications/job/{id}, /erp/materials, /erp/tools, /erp/estimates, /erp/bills, /complaints/mine all return 200 with capped lists (200 / 500 / 100 respectively) and no Mongo _id leak. (4) PDF/Excel exports — created TEST_iter8 bill, GET /api/erp/bills/{bid}/pdf returns real %PDF- bytes (proof reportlab importable + functional), GET .../excel returns real PK\x03\x04 zip header (proof openpyxl importable + functional). (5) Twilio dev mode — POST /api/auth/otp/send returns {sent:true, dev_mode:true, dev_code:'123456'}, OTP verify with 123456 successfully logs in existing user (NO Twilio creds needed → import + module-level client init does not crash). (6) Razorpay dev mode — GET /api/payments/pricing returns razorpay_enabled:false (MOCKED — expected). (7) requirements.txt sanity — twilio, razorpay, reportlab, openpyxl, emergentintegrations, litellm (wheel URL), fastapi, motor, bcrypt all present. (8) No regression: password change roundtrip, profile photo set/clear, complaints file+list, payroll all green. NOTE: The earlier minor concern (root /health not exposed via public ingress) remains by design — K8s pod-level probes must hit containerPort 8001 directly or use /api/health via the ingress.

minor.issue: Still only reachable on internal port 8001; public ingress only routes /api/*. If a K8s probe is configured at the ingress/Service level (not pod containerPort), it must use /api/health (or /api/healthz). Carry-over note from iteration_7; not a new issue.

rca_of_issue: Not a bug iteration — verification only. All three iteration-8 deployment-readiness fixes are working: (a) requirements.txt now contains every runtime dep (verified twilio, razorpay, reportlab, openpyxl, emergentintegrations, litellm wheel + 121 others), so a fresh pip install will not ImportError when /api/erp/bills/{id}/pdf, /excel, /payments/*, or /auth/otp/* are hit in production; (b) the 2-second asyncio.sleep before seed() gives K8s liveness/readiness probes a guaranteed window where /api/health responds without any DB activity, breaking the previous crash-loop where bcrypt-heavy seed blocked startup beyond the probe failure threshold; (c) the 8 newly added .limit() calls cap unbounded find() cursors at safe values (jobs/applications: 200, ERP collections: 500, complaints: 100), eliminating the risk of an event-loop-blocking large to_list() on Atlas as data grows. Combined with the still-active create_task wrapping of seed (iteration_7) and the no-DB health endpoints, the deployment-loop RCA is fully addressed.
